saw: RECORD showed "0 pulls . 0 kills" on a carried profile that the leveldb log proves already holds one real wipe from 2026-09-24 (The Two Flasks, 151.7s) -- because playbot's dev-server port is derived from process.pid and changes every invocation (5344, 5228, 5391, 5278, 5307, 5443, 5328 across this session's own seven runs), so localStorage never actually carries between separate playbot runs even with the same --profile; separately, the composition screen's spec picker draws the currently-selected tile at only 12% opacity over an 86%-opaque overlay, leaving the old roster row's text legible underneath and overlapping the new label into illegibility
message: A carried save never makes it past one playbot run, because the port it plays on never repeats
